Military escalation under the guise of energy security guarantees further supply shocks and perpetual warfare in the Persian Gulf.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing tactical retaliation (WHAT) with strategic stabilization (WHO). Punitive tanker destructions worsen the very energy crisis officials claim they are solving.

Social Physics Analysis:
Both Washington and Tehran run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using retaliatory pretexts to project blame onto adversaries while locking regional energy infrastructure into destructive cycles.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Escalating kinetic retaliation guarantees systemic regional destabilization.

The Unavoidable Truth: Force projection in critical chokepoints inevitably guarantees oil price spikes and supply shocks.

The Unavoidable Lie: Escalating maritime warfare is a reliable path to long-term energy security.
